name: io.github.versionpill/mcp
title: VersionPill
description: Product memory for coding agents: board, vision, and a public version customers understand.

features: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration)
Board profile by default: pulse, tasks, epics, cycles, ideas, ship draft
Entity-first tools: get a known card, then move or update it
desk_run batches up to 48 steps in one round-trip
Public changelog and customer version pill — no ticket IDs on the public page
useCases: Keep a coding agent on the current product without pasting the novel
Open a card, move it, comment, and draft a customer-facing release
Import a work tree instead of creating cards one by one
